red.completionTest: The new variation API was initially absent; the focused import failed before implementation.
red.fixedPathCase: A candidate that ignored relocated --input/--output values left the target output absent and was rejected as result-mismatch.
red.missingCwdCase: The checker initially surfaced an opaque spawn error; the red test required a stable variation-cwd diagnostic.

variationDesign.parameterPolicy: Only paired same-input observations are marked covered; a single observed value or missing semantic relation is skipped with source references.
variationDesign.caseInterface: Derived checks use ordinary validation cases (inputFiles, args, expectedFiles, and an isolated cwd); source-to-target bindings remain engine-internal.
variationDesign.authority: Task-contract or source-owned output checks are required for relocation; fidelity-only output is never promoted to task correctness.

claimBoundary: F5 is deterministic local development evidence with synthetic cases. It does not establish whole-skill correctness, real model behavior, readiness, human savings, prospective eligibility or held-out performance.
